description: Catch AI agent failures before they happen — retry loops, stuck multi-step tasks, wrong-tool-or-path mistakes — by injecting smart reminders before each request.
useCase: Stop an agent from getting stuck in retry loops or skipping steps on a long multi-step task, or warn when a Windows path is pasted into a Linux shell. First line of defense before running a quality review.

risks.risk: Soft prompt augmentation adds 150-400 tokens per fired guard, increasing latency and cost
risks.mitigation: Tune thresholds in references/thresholds.md; disable via env var or config switch if overhead is unacceptable

risks.risk: Default thresholds are calibrated for workstation usage; cloud/sandbox deployments may see false positives or misses
risks.mitigation: Review references/audit-log.md and validate thresholds with the claw-rl-prm-judge skill before production

risks.risk: Guardrails are advisory only and never block requests or modify tool output
risks.mitigation: Pair with ClawGuard intent-verifier or similar enforcement layer when blocking is required

output.format: Markdown guidance with inline JSON config examples and ESM handler reference
